## Why it matters

transcriptiones is a community platform for uploading, editing, and publishing transcriptions of historical manuscripts. Researchers can browse by institution, source type, or scribe and run full-text searches across contributed material.

Its metadata fields, version history, and bilingual interface make it useful for tracing manuscript traditions and reusing transcriptions in Swiss and broader manuscript research.
